checks.title: Safety Plan present and approved
checks.description: Verify existence of a Safety Plan covering lifecycle activities, roles, responsibilities, resources, and schedules, and that it is approved.

checks.title: Safety Plan updates and change control
checks.description: Confirm Safety Plan has versioning and change control to reflect evolving project scope and safety activities.

checks.title: Confirmation measures defined
checks.description: Check confirmation measures (reviews, audits, assessments) are planned with defined independence where required by ASIL.

checks.title: Roles, responsibilities, competence
checks.description: Verify roles and responsibilities for FuSa are identified and personnel competence criteria are defined.

checks.title: Customer/supplier safety interface agreement
checks.description: Check an agreement exists that defines safety responsibilities, work products, and evidence to be exchanged with suppliers/customers.

checks.title: Safety culture and escalation
checks.description: Confirm safety culture, escalation paths, and issue management processes are defined.
